notes: The last three screens in the programme — her Home, Notifications and Transaction feed. B7's Earnings and Profile were drawn with the money in b4-b7-the-money; this completes it.
her_home_was_built_right: Its own comment says the shape: 'one Your turn (N) tile → Collabs, active glance, recent activity, wallet'. It does not need rethinking, only filling in — the tile becomes ITEMS instead of a count, active collabs show WHICH of the six steps and WHOSE MOVE it is, and the money splits into what is hers and what is coming.
one_button_has_never_worked: ⚠️ HomeScreen shows 'Available to withdraw' with a WITHDRAW button under it, and THERE IS NO WITHDRAW SCREEN IN THE APP. The endpoint exists, the ₹100 minimum is enforced, the 10% TDS is calculated — the button leads nowhere. Same gap b4-b7 found from the Earnings side: two entry points, one missing screen.
every_money_line_carries_a_date: The habit applied throughout: a rupee is always shown with the day it becomes hers. That single convention is what stops a creator believing she is owed something nobody plans to send.
the_returned_sale_screen: NEW, and the second card is the point: 'Nothing was taken from your wallet — commission only reaches your wallet 7 days after a sale, and this one came back on day 2.' A reversal she does not understand is the fastest way to lose a creator's trust, and under the 7-day rule it is genuinely harmless.
counts_stay_on_the_server: Home's badge, the Collabs tab badge and the brand's 'needs you' are one server answer read three times. Stated in the document so nobody later computes it on the phone.
multi_brand_posts_answered: Founder, 2026-09-01: no count for multi-brand posts. Only single-brand posts count towards a set's minimum, because only they belong to one collaboration.

release.deploy_class: deploy-inert — mockups and specification only, no code

superseded_why: Organised by TAB — how the app is built, not how anyone uses it — so the same screen appears here and in other b-files with a different description each time. Replaced by the Screen Atlas, where each of the 109 screens is drawn ONCE at a permanent address (SB-/SC-/SA-) and the 47 actions point at it. Kept, not deleted: the notes below record the founder’s corrections round by round, and that history is not reproduced in the atlas. approved stays false, so this contract can never back a change.
